_README: Per-leg CEILING on the number of SKIPPED tests in the skills CI shard legs (skills#2127).
Enforced by scripts/check_skip_budget.py, called once per leg from the `run shard` step of
.github/workflows/skills-validate.yml. Keys are the leg labels the shard prints as
::group:: headers (the literal legs) and the per-skill suite directory names.
A label with NO entry gets a ceiling of 0 - nothing escapes the budget by omission.
THIS IS A RATCHET, NOT A FLOOR. When skips go away, LOWER the number in the SAME PR;
leftover slack is a permanent ceiling that hides the next regression beneath it.
Specifically: skills#2090 (un-skip the contracts validators) MUST ratchet these DOWN.
MEASURE ON CI, NEVER LOCALLY: a dev box has AWS credentials and a resolvable contracts
root, so it skips LESS than the runner and would freeze a baseline that is too tight.
Every leg emits `::notice title=skip-budget::skip-budget[<leg>]: N skipped <= budget M
(K outcomes reported)`, so `gh run view <run-id> --log | grep skip-budget` prints the
whole table in one shot. To see WHICH tests skipped and why, read the leg's own -rs
`short test summary info` block in the same log.
_measured: CI run 36616099569 (PR#2163, head 93aa7c38, 2026-09-29): 24 legs, 162 skips total. The two large ones are _skills_common (135 of 3339 outcomes, dominated by the credential-less runner's live-S3 self-skips) and skills-guards (17 of 564).
